text:
Aisha (PM): quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone rollup for Inference runtime improvements. TL;DR: core rollout shipped, GPU autoscale slipped, two blocker deps for private deploy. Who owns next steps?

Mateo (Eng): shipped: runtime v2.1 canary completed, perf numbers match target +12% throughput. :tada:

Aisha (PM): nice. Mateo, can you drop the perf dashboard link? also list any followups for docs / SDKs.

Mateo (Eng): dashboard: https://redwood.ci/dashboards/runtime-v2-1 (internal)
- followups: SDK flag for new quant profile (PR #482), docs blurb for rollout behavior, add metrics tag 'v2.1'

Jordan (Eng): FYI, SDK PR is merged to staging but needs one more e2e before prod. I can take it Mon.

Priya (SRE): slipping: GPU autoscale policy (dedicated) — we hit a weird double-scaling race in canary, reverted autopilot tweak. Root cause is the concurrency estimator overshoot.

Aisha (PM): who owns the autoscale fix? ETA?

Priya (SRE): assigning to Li to follow up on estimator heuristics. ETA EOD Wednesday for a mitigation (lower aggressiveness + circuit-breaker).

Li (Eng-Platform): ack. I'll post a short RFC w/ the config change and a test plan. Blocking note: need perf test infra tweak (small infra work).

Sam (Data): dependency note: the bk-store schema change (for KV cache persistence) is required for Private deploys; Payments infra team pushed their migration window later. That causes private rollout slip.

Aisha (PM): who is owning coordination with Payments infra?

Sam (Data): Jordan volunteered in earlier sync to pair with Payments on the migration. Jordan?

Jordan (Eng): I can pick that up. I'll ping Payments and propose a migration window next Tue/Wed. Will update here.

Mateo (Eng): blocking item for me: we have one remaining flaky e2e test around long-context recompute. I can triage but might need help from Priya to repro in canary.

Priya (SRE): I can repro in the staging cluster, DM me logs and I'll attach traces.

Aisha (PM): good. Quick owner summary for the tracker (please reply with one-line commits):
- Mateo: SDK + perf followups, e2e triage (ETA Mon/Tue)
- Li: autoscale estimator mitigation RFC + test plan (ETA Wed EOD)
- Jordan: Payments migration coordination for bk-store schema (propose window by Mon)
- Priya: assist with e2e repro and implement temporary autoscale rollback if needed
- Sam: verify Private deploy smoke after Payments migration

Jordan (Eng): one-line: I will coordinate Payments and propose Tue/Wed migration window by EOD Mon.

Mateo (Eng): one-line: triage e2e flaky test + merge SDK e2e gating, ETA Tue.

Li (Eng-Platform): one-line: post autoscale mitigation RFC + test plan, ETA Wed EOD.

Priya (SRE): one-line: repro e2e in staging and attach traces; hold rollback plan, ETA Tue morning.

Sam (Data): one-line: run Private deploy smoke after migration, report pass/fail, ETA Wed.

deploy-bot: deploy log: runtime-v2.1 canary -> 10% traffic @ 1773003500, rollback patch applied @ 1773004200 for GP autoscale test.

Aisha (PM): thanks all. I'll update the OKR doc after these commits. If anything slips further, please tag me and add a short rationale (customer impact + mitigation). :thumbsup:
